text: I wake up at 6:30 a.m. every day, even on weekends, because I value consistency. First, I drink a glass of water, stretch lightly, and have a simple breakfast like oatmeal or eggs. By 8:00 a.m., I start my work schedule, which involves checking emails, attending online meetings, and completing tasks until lunch. In the afternoon, I take a 30-minute break to exercise—usually a brisk walk or a short yoga session. This helps me stay energized for the remaining work. By 6:00 p.m., I stop working. In the evening, I prepare dinner, read a book or watch a show, and then wind down with a cup of herbal tea. I’m usually in bed by 10:30 p.m., ready to do it all again.
